doc.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Why he plays other people's songs
summary: He is not a composer and tests material by whether it bores him.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Which is exactly the reason why I play other people’s songs. Because I am not a composer. And I’m not going to write a bunch of tunes to put on a record just to have © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
some publishing money. I get bored listening to whole records of other people doing that. So that’s my big test for myself. Is this going to bore me?
Well that’s a pretty good — what do you call it — litmus test?
If it bores you it’s probably going to bore someone else.
